# OSTEOMYELITIS WITH STREPTOCOCCI

---

References:

- Sanford keyword: Osteomyelitis
- Mandell chapter: Osteomyelitis
- Lew DP Lancet 2004, 364: 369
- Cunha BA Clin Infect Dis 2002, 35: 287
Therapy:
## Inpatient

### Treatment

Penicillin G 4 million units IV q4h ($) [R] < OR >
Cefazolin 2 gm IV q8h ($) [R] < OR >
Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO q12h ($) [R,DI] < OR >
Cephalexin 500 mg PO q6h ($) [R] < OR >
Dicloxacillin 500 mg PO q6h ($) [DI]

## Outpatient

### Treatment

Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO BID ($) [R,DI] < Cephalexin 500 mg PO QID ($) [R] < OR >
Dicloxacillin 500 mg PO QID ($) [DI]
